title: Who Wins?
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about power. Every monster has one number, and when two meet, the stronger one wins. A big red gumdrop pops the small ones blocking a tunnel by itself, then Lami throws stars and finds out which foes their star can pop and which one is too strong. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a power.

box.back: A small explorer in a red beanie crosses two short rooms. Two small gumdrops block a tunnel, and a big red one is stronger than they are. Watch who wins, throw a star to find out how strong it is, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a power.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Every monster has a power, and the stronger one wins
Made to be copied and taken apart
